verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's own docs say Stripe generates events on every verification-session status change. They also give a guide for implementing webhooks that notify your app so the integration can react automatically, which directly delivers outbound event subscriptions. Missing for 10: an explicit catalog of subscribable Identity event types and endpoint-registration/signature details in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the webhook flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Stripe generates events every time a session changes status. In this guide, we’ll implement webhooks to notify your app when verification results become available.
Listen for verification results so your integration can automatically trigger reactions.
